channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: El Caucus Hispano del Congreso pide retirar el nombre de César Chávez de lugares públicos y feriados
item.description: El New York Times informó el miércoles que al menos dos mujeres, que eran niñas cuando trabajaron con Chávez, afirman que fueron agredidas sexualmente por él.

item.title: March heat breaks records across southwestern U.S., on track for more
item.description: The aptly named town of Thermal, in the California desert northeast of San Diego, was forecast to hit 110 degrees on Friday.

item.title: Bomb threats against schools not credible, says Chula Vista PD
item.description: The anonymous voicemails "were received overnight at multiple schools, and officers are currently on campus working with school security."

item.title: Crews halt brush fire near San Diego, Riverside County border
item.description: The Crosley Fire was first reported at 11:48 a.m. at state Highway 79 and Crosley Truck Trail, according to Cal Fire.

item.title: The video that changed the narrative of a fatal beating on the border
item.description: Ashley Young became part of a growing legion to bear witness to state violence at the hands of U.S. immigration officials.

item.title: Water authority announces long-term sale of surplus to Riverside County
item.description: The San Diego County Water Authority struck a 21-year deal to sell its surplus to Western Municipal Water, potentially offsetting rates for local customers.

item.title: Eight concerts to see in San Diego this week
item.description: Whether your tastes run to classic country, classical chamber, or sludge metal, you'll find something to satisfy your auditory appetite.

item.title: Heroic librarian, born on this day in 1906, brought light to Japanese children in internment camps
item.description: Breed, San Diego's city librarian for 25 years, became a connection to children she met on the job after they were sent away to the camps.

item.title: Live long and prosper – in San Diego County, life expectancy outpaces California, US
item.description: A child born in San Diego in 2024 is expected to live into his or her 80s, but community and ethnicity have an impact too.

item.title: City, county officials move to re-name March 31 holiday that honors César Chávez
item.description: The reaction to the late Chávez's downfall includes efforts to change the name of the holiday in his honor in both the city and county of San Diego.
